card.name: Computer-feature nouns after a modifier
card.fires_on: A noun in software or computer-help text that follows a modifier, such as 'folders' after 'shared', 'favourites' after 'browser', or 'alias' after 'user'. It also fires on the single word 'hold' after 'treatment' in a dosing list.
